SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY s_suppkey

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c_custkey,
        COUNT(o_orderkey) as c_count
    FROM customer
    JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey
    WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'
    GROUP BY c_custkey
)
SELECT
    c_count,
    COUNT(c_custkey) as custdist
FROM customer_order_counts
GROUP BY c_count
ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC

  o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate

    AND s2.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
)
ORDER BY s.s_name;

SELECT
    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
  AND l.l_receiptdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_receiptdate < '1995-01-01'
  AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
  AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand NOT LIKE 'Brand#45%'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-04-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT 
    s_suppkey,
    s_name,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY s_suppkey;
```

FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'

  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  AND ps.ps_availqty > (

      AND l2.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY s.s_name

SELECT
  l_returnflag,
  l_linestatus,
  SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
  SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
  AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
  AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
  AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
  COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate <= '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT

  s_name,
  n_name,
  p_partkey,
  p_mfgr,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  s_comment
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    n.n_regionkey,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment,
    ps.ps_supplycost
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
) AS subquery
WHERE subquery.ps_supplycost = (
  SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost)
  FROM partsupp ps2
  JOIN part p2 ON ps2.ps_partkey = p2.p_partkey
  WHERE p2.p_partkey = subquery.p_partkey
)
ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey
LIMIT 100

    c.c_name,
    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_totalprice,
    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS sum_quantity
FROM
    customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY
    c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice
HAVING
    SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY
    o.o_totalprice DESC,

  COUNT(*) AS numcust,
  SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM customer c
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE c.c_phone LIKE '13%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '31%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '23%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '29%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '30%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '18%' OR c.c_phone LIKE '17%'
  AND c.c_acctbal > (
    SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal)
    FROM customer c2
    WHERE c2.c_phone LIKE '13%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '31%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '23%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '29%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '30%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '18%' OR c2.c_phone LIKE '17%'
  )
  AND c.c_custkey NOT IN (
    SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o
  )
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
ORDER BY c.c_nationkey
```
